family.selection: Every retained prime tile whose exact subgroup order n divides 5040.

nonclaims: This instrumentation tranche is not a fresh context-isolated scientific episode.
Local-search exhaustion is not UNSAT for the selected family.
A timeout or bounded null is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
A producer candidate requires the frozen independent verifier and an attributed human Decision before Standing can change.

search.algorithm: Fixed-seed min-conflicts over exact-one tile shifts, followed by deterministic counterexample-guided uncovered-point additions and a complete 5040 by 5040 torus scan for any candidate satisfying the accumulated constraints.
search.stopping_rule: Stop at the first exact full-torus cover candidate, inability to satisfy the accumulated sound point constraints within the fixed move budget, the iteration cap, or the wall-clock cap.
